**主旨:稿件 SYN-DET-2026-0457 修訂稿與審稿回覆**

編輯與審稿人您好:

感謝您們審閱本稿〈以 SiPM 讀出之塑膠閃爍體計時探測器:時間解析度量測方法〉,也感謝三位意見提供的建議。修訂稿與逐點回覆如下。

**審稿意見 R1(模擬交叉驗證)**

審稿人建議以第二套獨立的模擬程式重做光收集模擬。我們仔細考慮後,決定不增做這項工作,理由如下:

1. 現有模擬已與實驗台量測驗證。在 5 個入射位置上,光產額的資料與模擬一致性都在 3% 以內(圖 6)。
2. 本文的結論,即時間解析度,完全來自量測。模擬只用來說明光收集的幾何趨勢,不影響文中任何結果數值。因此第二套模擬不會改變本文的結論。
3. 要建立第二套模擬,必須重新量測表面反射率,才能建立另一套光學表面模型。這超出本文的範圍。

為回應審稿人的關切,我們已在第 3.3 節新增一句,說明本文僅使用單一模擬程式,以及該模擬與量測的驗證情況。

**審稿意見 R2(溫度控制下的量測)**

已完成。我們補充了 25 ± 0.5 °C 控溫條件下的時間解析度量測,結果見第 4.2 節與表 3。25 °C 下 σ_t = 48 ± 2 ps,溫度在 ±0.5 °C 範圍內變化時,σ_t 的變化小於 3 ps。

**審稿意見 R3(圖 7)**

已完成。圖 7 橫軸單位已由 ns 改為 ps,數值不變。

| R2 | 新增控溫量測 | 第 4.2 節、表 3 |
| R3 | 橫軸單位改為 ps | 圖 7 |

再次感謝審稿人與編輯的寶貴意見,也希望 R1 的處理方式能獲得諒解。

敬祝 順心

**Response to the referee: manuscript SYN-2026-0219**
"Precision measurement of the cosmic-ray proton flux from 1 GV to 1.8 TV with the SYN-Spec space spectrometer"

We thank the referee for the careful reading and for the three comments. We have addressed each one in the revised manuscript. Our replies follow, with the referee's comments in italics.

**R1 (geomagnetic cutoff).** *The systematic uncertainty from the geomagnetic cutoff safety factor is not given. Please vary the factor (nominal 1.2) and include the effect in the systematics.*

We agree. We repeated the analysis with the safety factor varied from its nominal value of 1.2 to 1.0 and to 1.4. The resulting flux change is at most 1.1% below 30 GV and below 0.1% above 30 GV. This is described in a new paragraph in Sec. 5.4. It is included as a new row in the systematic-uncertainty summary in Table 4.

**R2 (data availability).** *Please provide the flux values in all rigidity bins as a table.*

We added Supplementary Table S2. It gives the proton flux with statistical and systematic uncertainties in all 45 rigidity bins from 1 GV to 1800 GV.

**R3 (livetime).** *Eq. (3) defines the livetime fraction with the dead time in the numerator; this appears to be a typo. Please correct it and confirm the results are unaffected.*

The referee is correct. Eq. (3) now reads: livetime fraction = 1 − (dead time / total time). The error was only in the printed equation. The analysis code already used the correct definition. To confirm this, we reran the full analysis on 2026-10-22. All flux values were reproduced identically to four significant digits, so no result changes.

The changes are marked in the revised manuscript. We hope the revision now meets the referee's requirements.

Sincerely,
[author names]

# Response to the Referee: SYN-2026-0412 (synthetic evaluation material)

**Manuscript:** "Measurement of the inclusive Λc+ production cross section in pp collisions at √s = 13.6 TeV with the XYZ detector"

Dear Editor, dear Referee,

Thank you for your report. Of the three points, one (R3) is addressed in the revised manuscript. The other two (R1, R2) require reprocessing that is still running, so we address them below with what we will do and when. No results exist yet for these two. We therefore request an extension of the 2026-11-05 deadline to [DATE: suggest no earlier than 2026-11-26], so that the revised manuscript can contain the results of both studies.

**R1 (pileup systematic).** *The pileup-reweighting uncertainty is not evaluated. Please vary σ_MB by ±4.6% and propagate the effect to the cross section, and list it in Table 3.*

We agree. This is not yet done. The full analysis chain with σ_MB varied by ±4.6% was submitted to the grid on 2026-10-28, with output expected on 2026-11-12. We will propagate the variation to the cross section and add a pileup row to Table 3. We will also update the total systematic uncertainty, which is currently 6.1% and unchanged in this version. [VALUE NEEDED: pileup uncertainty on the cross section from the σ_MB ±4.6% variation; updated total systematic in Table 3.]

**R2 (unfolding closure).** *Please provide a closure test of the Bayesian unfolding using an alternative (flat) prior, and quote the resulting uncertainty.*

We agree. This is not yet done. The flat-prior unfolding requires the response matrix produced by the rerun in R1, so it cannot start before 2026-11-12. We estimate it will finish by 2026-11-19. We will add the closure test and quote the resulting uncertainty in the revised manuscript. [VALUE NEEDED: flat-prior closure result, resulting uncertainty, manuscript locator.]

**R3 (trigger efficiency).** *The definition of the trigger efficiency in Sec. 4.2 is ambiguous (per event or per candidate?). Please clarify and state the value used.*

Done. Sec. 4.2 has been rewritten (lines 212–230 of the revised draft). The trigger efficiency is now defined per event, in the new Eq. (7). The value used is ε_trig = 0.962 ± 0.004 (stat) ± 0.006 (syst), now listed in Table 2.

We thank the Referee for these suggestions and will send the complete revision as soon as the R1 and R2 results are available.

Sincerely,
[Corresponding author name], on behalf of the authors
